title: Organization repositories
summary: The owner links the organization's repositories on the site by connecting GitHub, GitLab or Bitbucket. The app lists them, and each member clones them with their own git access.
usage: On the site, open the organization, go to Repositories, connect a provider and add the repositories. In the app, Repositories in the organization's side menu lists them: choose the organization folder, clone what's missing, and use Find clones to compare the folder with the list. On GitHub, connecting installs the JayV GitHub App, which only reaches the repositories you pick; click GitHub again to add more. An owner or maintainer deletes an organization project on the site, in the Projects tab; it leaves every member's app with its chats, and the repository stays.
